main_text.p: 48 Hæc est hæreditas tribus filio-rum Dan per familias suas, ciuitates i-stæ, & villæ earum.
49 Quum autem finem fecissent partiendi terram vt possiderét singuli terminos suos, dederunt filii Israel hereditatem ipsi Iosue filio Nun in medio sui.
50 Secundum sermonem Iehouæ dederūt ei vrbem quam petiuit, Thimnath-serah in monte Ephraim: & ædificauit vrbem, habitauitque in ea.

51 Istæ sunt hereditates quas tradiderunt possidendas Eleazar sacerdos, & Iosue filius Nun, & principes patrum tribuum filiorum Israel per sortem in Silo coram Iehoua ad ostium tabernaculi conuentionis, & finem fecerunt diuidendi terram.

Nunc de forte Nephthali, quæ videtur congruere ingenio & moribus illius familiæ. Iacob Genes. 49.21 enim testatus fuerat mansuetos fore, & qui blandis sermonibus vicinos mulcerent. Hac ratione videntur contigui ab vna parte fuisse filiùs Iudæ:

page.notes: The right margin carries handwritten marginalia in ink/pencil which are not printed text and are omitted. The note "Genes. 49.21" is printed in the margin beside the commentary; the abbreviation as printed reads "Genef." Some words are uncertain in the scan (e.g., "filiùs" may be "filius"); the last line is partly faded. Pencil underlining on "Iosue" and "Eleazar" is not transcribed.
